== frame and_short_circuit cursor=3,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ false && echo no; echo $?
|1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 false
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame or_short_circuit cursor=6,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ false && echo no; echo $?
|1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ true || echo no; echo $?
|0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 false
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 true
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame chain cursor=9,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ false && echo no; echo $?
|1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ true || echo no; echo $?
|0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ false || false || echo third
|third
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 false
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 true
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@6 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 false
@9 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame sequence cursor=14,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ false && echo no; echo $?
|1
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ true || echo no; echo $?
|0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ false || false || echo third
|third
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo a; echo b; echo c
|a
|b
|c
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 false
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 true
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@6 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 false
@9 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@9 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@14 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
